description: Burst generator: while a gate is held it fires bursts spaced by a randomised time and sends each one to one of eight step outputs

params.text: Steps through the three burst modes in turn; the lit lamp shows whether single, multi or seq is in force
Sets the base time between bursts, 0 to 10 seconds
Sets how far each gap strays from the base time, 0% to 100%; at 50% a gap falls anywhere between half and one and a half times the base
Sets this step's weight, 0 to 1: in single mode the chance the burst picks this step, in multi the chance it fires on its own, in seq the chance the burst moves on to it; at 0 the step is never used
Switches this step's CV output between holding the voltage taken when its burst arrived and passing the CV input through for as long as the step fires

inputs.text: Bursts are fired only while the voltage here is above 0V; taking it low stops them and clears the timer
The voltage the step CV outputs carry; every channel of a polyphonic cable is passed on

outputs.text: Carries the CV input for this step: with sh off it follows the input while the step fires and drops to 0V otherwise, with sh on it holds the voltage taken at the last burst
10V while the burst is on this step, 0V otherwise

notes: no burst is fired until the gate input is taken above 0V, and a step whose weight knob is at 0 is never chosen.
when the gate input goes low the step the module stopped on keeps its gate output at 10V until a later burst moves off it.

inputs.0: high above 0V · stepped · one channel only
